stem: Which detail from paragraph 11 of the excerpt from Finding Dorothy and from paragraph 7 of the excerpt from “Big Wheels Keep On Turnin’ ” supports the key idea that people are fascinated by new inventions?

options.label: A
options.text: The information about the price people paid to ride the Ferris wheel and the amount of money Ferris made

options.label: B
options.text: The facts about how the Ferris wheel was designed to look similar to the Eiffel Tower in Paris

options.label: C
options.text: The information about the first and second locations where the Ferris wheel was displayed for the public

options.label: D
options.text: The facts about how the steel spindles and frame were visible from a long distance away
